name: Hard Knocks
text:
Uses (2 resources). Replenish these resources at the start of each round.
[fast] Spend 1 resource from your resource pool or from Hard Knocks: You get +1 [combat] or +1 [agility] for this skill test.
text_cn:
使用(2资源)。当每轮开始时重新补满这些资源。
[free]花费你的资源池或沉重打击的1资源：这次技能检定你+1[combat]或+1[agility]。
